briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multi-agent AGI capabilities

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with new reasoning models while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Compute shortages persist amid massive data center expansions. Prompt injection attacks continue to dominate real-world deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with 2.3T parameters focused on long-horizon planning. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus shows gains in code generation. DeepSeek-V4 undercuts pricing at $0.08 per million tokens.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins volume production of 1.6nm AI chips. Microsoft announces $45B hyperscale buildout in Texas and Germany. NVIDIA Blackwell supply remains constrained through Q4.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the capability gap with closed labs by end of 2027?
